caption: The drawing depicts a front view and a partial back outline of a vest. The vest has a high, standing collar and is illustrated with alternating horizontal stripes of red and light pink. The light pink stripes contain a repeating green floral or vine motif. The vest has a vertical row of six round buttons at the center front. The collar and the inner lining are shown in a light, beige color. The back outline of the vest, located in the upper left portion of the drawing, is indicated with simple black lines and does not include any color or pattern. The artist's name, "Louis Maldarelli," and the date, "May 5th, 1937," are written in the lower left corner of the image. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Waistcoat
